reading: The whole segmentation release carries 581 annotated frames. To clear a 300-frame line, 52% of every annotated frame in the dataset would have to contain a clip. Clipping is one phase of a cholecystectomy, and the release's own dedicated Clipping set holds 115 frames -- below the line on its own. The gate is at genuine risk of dying on volume, and that is known before a single mask is opened.
